To write down the elements of ${D}_{0},$ we substitute $i=0$ into the expression and get

$$
\begin{aligned}{D}_{0} & =\{2(0)-1,-0,1,0+2\} \\  & =\{-1,0,1,2\}.\end{aligned}
$$
